purpose: Renders a deterministic license term sheet by substituting field values into a pre-approved template (CC-STANDARD-USE, IP3-RIGHTS-RECORD, NFT-EMBEDDED-LICENSE). No bespoke legal drafting. Outputs rendered plain text and HTML. Not legal advice. Substitution into fixed templates only.
